description: Estimate the credit cost of create_actor WITHOUT spending credits. Call this first and show the price before create_actor: each requested format is a separate charged image.

approximate_age.description: Approximate age in years, 18 to 90: actors are adults. Required unless from_actor_id is given.

aspect_ratios.description: Formats to create: 9:16 | 1:1 | 16:9, always including 9:16. Omitted means all three.

description.description: Words describing a fictional adult: appearance, clothing, setting.

framing.description: wide: the camera further back, the head lower with room above; make_ugc then renders it as a wide view.

from_actor_id.description: Derive a new personal actor from this one (a library actor or your own): the same face, gender and age, with the view changed by framing, holding or setting.

gender.description: female | male. Fixes the actor's gender and the default voice of videos with this actor. Required unless from_actor_id is given.

holding.description: Up to 2 objects the presenter holds, one per hand.

description.description: The object, e.g. "a white coffee mug".

hand.description: left | right; omitted lets the edit choose.

reference.description: A PNG or JPEG picture of the object: an image asset of this account (upload,…

quality.description: Image quality: medium | high. Omitted means medium. The price per image depends on it; quote shows it before any charge.

setting.description: The room or background to put the presenter in, in words.

name: quote_actor
title: Quote a personal actor
